node.statement: Maximal-simplex antecedent. Under the singleton hypothesis of node 1.5, the homeomorphism of breve-calU with a finite simplicial complex makes it a finite polyhedron, and lem-finite-polyhedron-maximal-simplex-placement places its sole fixed point breve-e in a maximal simplex. Hence the maximal-simplex hypothesis of lem-topology-lefschetz-hopf is satisfied.
